headline: Latest recorded developments
verification_note: A manually checked, partial collection of primary-source updates. The three records listed below were last checked on 11 October 2026 and were not re-checked for this release. This is not a live feed or a completed five-year systematic search. Older records are dated archive entries, not new announcements. News inclusion does not admit a method to a benchmark.
coverage_gaps: No directly eligible, currently open new-product cold-start forecasting competition was verified in this partial search.
No newly released commercial tool was independently validated against genuine zero-history or <=28-calendar-day first-launch cases.
News checks do not establish complete coverage of papers, events or products.

items.title: Attention based Multi-Modal New Product Sales Time-series Forecasting
items.summary: Attention-based models forecast new fashion-product sales from images, attributes and external signals without product sales history.
items.short_summary: Images and attributes predict sales before the first sale.
items.why_it_matters: The official conference abstract explicitly specifies no historical time series for new products and fashion-retail evaluation. Metadata is confirmed by IBM Research.
items.scope: Direct zero-history task stated in official abstract. Full-text protocol, exact retailer-wide first-launch identity and origin-time signals are not verified.
limitations: Before the five-year primary window; older lineage only.
Official abstract inspected; ACM access unavailable. No numerical scores extracted or benchmark admission.
Already in historical R08 triage; newly added to the public news catalog, not newly discovered research.

items.title: Dif4FF explores multiple sales paths for unreleased fashion items
items.summary: Dif4FF conditions a diffusion model on clothing information and refines generated sales paths with a graph network. The paper evaluates new-fashion-product forecasting on VISUELLE.
items.why_it_matters: It is a candidate for testing richer launch trajectories. Generated paths do not by themselves establish calibrated uncertainty, retail-scale operation or revenue improvement.
items.scope: Zero-own-sales new-fashion-product task; provisional direct-task fit, not an independently reproduced result.
items.short_summary: Forecasts new fashion products from images and signals.

items.title: MDiFF provides an author-linked diffusion implementation
items.summary: MDiFF generates possible sales paths for new fashion items and uses a small neural network to refine the point forecast. Its arXiv page links author code.
items.why_it_matters: The code link gives the Builder a starting point for a reproduction audit. Code was not executed here; the paper overlaps with Dif4FF and is not independent corroboration.
items.scope: Zero-own-sales fashion task. Artifact version, license, dependencies and fair comparison still need review.
items.short_summary: A new-product forecasting paper with linked code.

applications.title: Plan an opening assortment before the first sale
applications.decision: Choose new styles and initial buying budgets using product attributes and forecasts.
applications.limitations: Historical 2019 Myntra-Jabong case, outside the current five-year discovery window. Authors report assortment-budget use and observational sell-through changes, not controlled revenue or our benchmark results. Not an endorsement or customer relationship.

applications.title: Size the first order for a new seasonal or replenishable SKU
applications.decision: Compare opening stock and early replenishment choices for a genuinely new item.
signals: Separate store and delivery H3 resolution-7 cells
applications.limitations: Proposed application, not a validated deployment. Seasonal and replenishable products need separate protocols; weather and plans must be known at the forecast date. No accuracy or monetary benefit established.

applications.title: Separate launch sales from net-new growth
applications.decision: Compare a new product's demand with substitution and cannibalization before committing launch resources.
applications.limitations: Industry presentation motivates this opportunity, but the proposed lab application is not validated. Forecast accuracy and incremental sales require separate evidence; no cross-industry method transfer is established.

applications.title: Set initial stock for a newly introduced part
applications.decision: Balance service availability and inventory cost for a new part without its own demand history.
applications.limitations: Future domain-expansion opportunity. Sparse demand in an established part is not a new-part launch. A dedicated genuine first-launch dataset and protocol are required before admission.

applications.title: Plan capacity for a newly launched offering
applications.decision: Explore launch demand and capacity needs before product-specific usage exists.
applications.limitations: Future domain-expansion opportunity, outside the active retail unit-sales benchmark. Downloads, visits and popularity are not interchangeable with purchases or revenue. No validated method or result is claimed.
